author: Lütken, 1856

note.en: A spiny brittle star of shallow reef rubble, known here from two museum records. Disc size is an approximate field-guide value.
note.es: Una ofiura espinosa del escombro somero de arrecife, conocida aquí por dos registros de museo. El tamaño del disco es un valor aproximado de guías de campo.

evidence: GBIF: 2 records in the region (many are museum specimens)

sources.t: WoRMS: World Register of Marine Species, accepted name and range

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 2 records in the region (many are museum specimens).

marks.en: Spiny brittle star with long thin arms banded in brown and white.
marks.es: Ofiura espinosa de brazos largos y finos con bandas pardas y blancas.
